title: Small perfect isomorphism classes on an open
statement: For a scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme] and an open subset $U$ of $X$, define $P_w(X,U)$ to mean: for every scheme $Y$ and open immersion $f:Y\to X$ with image $U$, and every choice of derived categories of morphism universe $w$ for the module sheaves on $Y$ and on its open sites [def-pc-derived-category], the skeleton of the full subcategory of perfect objects [def-pc-perfect-complex] of $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)$ is $u$-small. Here $X,Y$ and their module sheaves are in universe $u$, a skeleton is the quotient of objects by isomorphism, and $u$-small means equivalent as a type to a type in universe $u$.
